The '''Eye of Zallow''' was a massive dodecahedron similar in style to a [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] suspended over a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] pad in the [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. It was orbited by two smaller holocron-shaped objects.<ref name="TORE" />

The Eye was constructed sometime during the Temple's construction between [[3650 BBY/Legends|3650]]&ndash;[[3647 BBY]]<ref name="Codex" /> and was named after the fallen [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ven Zallow]], who had [[Death/Legends|died]] in the [[Sacking of Coruscant]] in [[3653 BBY]] that ended the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="TORE" /> When the Sith Empire [[Assault on Tython|attacked]] Tython<ref name="Assault" /> around [[3637 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the Jedi Temple came under assault, and during the chaos, the Eye of Zallow's repulsorlift was damaged, sending the Eye crashing to the floor.<ref name="Assault" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Eye of Zallow first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]]. It was given a name in the [[2012]] reference guide ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="TORE" />
